known_rules.symptom: Equal-sized function differs in scratch-register pushes or call argument setup, and an isolated peer-definition change alters its bytes without changing its body.
known_rules.known_source_cause: GCC 4.4.1 peep2_find_free_register retains search_ofs across successful scratch searches; earlier compiled functions can affect later scratch selection. Not every register mismatch is this cause.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Keep production flags and protected bodies. Supervisor runs compiler_probe.py and compares focused RTL passes. Resolve historical CU context once; do not keep rewriting the target or mask register bytes.
